title: Laszlo Nyelvtanuló | Offline Spanish–Hungarian learning for Windows
description: Spanish–Hungarian vocabulary practice for Windows with a Hungarian-only interface. Flashcards, quizzes, listening and personal images. Free 30-day trial; then €19 + VAT for one PC.
heading:
Turn vocabulary
into knowledge you can use.
intro: Learn word pairs, listen to their pronunciation and check what you remember. A standalone Windows application for learning at your own pace.
languageDetail: This presentation page is available in three languages. The application and PDF guide are in Hungarian; the learning material is Spanish–Hungarian. English and Spanish application interfaces are not currently available.
priceShort: Then €19 + VAT · one PC · one-time purchase
previewCaption: The Hungarian application overview. Click to enlarge.
howText: Different words need different approaches. Choose a topic, then switch between flashcards, listening exercises and games.
step1Text: Greetings, home, travel or grammar expressions: focus on what you need right now.
step2Text: Listen to the words, add your own example sentences and associate them with meaningful pictures.
step3Text: Mistakes go into a dedicated collection, and scheduled review helps you revisit them regularly.
f1Text: Spanish and Hungarian side by side with a hidden-translation option. Multiple-choice and typed answers in either direction.
f2Text: Listen to Spanish, choose its meaning or write what you hear. A local Windows speech voice allows offline playback.
f3Text: Hangman, picture exercises, translation matching and Spanish opposite pairs.
f4Text: Add words and example sentences, edit entries, and preview Excel/CSV imports before approving them.
f5Text: Upload and replace pictures with automatic resizing. A 600 MB image library stored separately on your computer.
f6Text: Difficult words, scheduled review, topic-level progress and results from completed practice sessions.
personalText: A few example images and built-in drawings demonstrate the feature. Choose your own favourite picture for each word: Szótáram → Szerkesztés → Saját kép (Dictionary → Edit → Personal image).
personalLimits: Upload JPG, PNG or WebP up to 4 MB. The application preserves proportions and converts it to no more than 512 × 512 pixels and 64 KB. The 600 MB library holds approximately 9,600 maximum-size images.
personalBackup: The application keeps its own copy, so the original file can be moved later. A full ZIP backup includes your pictures and learning data. Older JSON backups can also be restored.
galleryIntro: The screenshots show the program’s Hungarian interface. The program is available only in Hungarian; this website can be viewed in Hungarian, Spanish or English.
downloadTitle: Try it for 30 days without requesting a licence.
downloadText: The trial begins on first launch and includes all learning features. Simply reinstalling the application does not restart the trial.
setupText: Download and run the installer, then open the app from the desktop or Start menu shortcut. No separate Excel installation or browser is required.
manualText: A 22-page illustrated PDF covering exercises, personal pictures, ZIP backups, the trial and activation. The guide is in Hungarian only.
voiceNote: Pronunciation requires a local Spanish Windows speech voice. An internet connection may be needed for its initial download; practice then works offline.
licenseTitle: Continue with a licence when it suits you.
licenseTerm: One-time purchase · one Windows PC · perpetual use of the purchased version
license1: In the application’s Licenc tab, save the licence request file for your computer.
license2: Send it by email. We will arrange payment and purchase details.
license3: After payment is received, import the supplied .lic file using Licencfájl beolvasása (Import licence file). No licence key needs to be copied by hand.
licenseNote: Your learning data remains after the trial expires, and backup is still available. The licence is tied to one computer; contact us when changing PC or reinstalling Windows.
subject: Laszlo Nyelvtanuló – licence request
emailBody: Hello, I would like to request a one-PC licence for Laszlo Nyelvtanuló. I will attach the licence request file saved from the application.
securityText: The supplied VirusTotal screenshots show 0/69 detections for both the 1.0.3 installer and the launcher EXE. Open the complete reports below.
avgText: For the temporary file checked during installation and shown in the screenshot, AVG found no hidden threats.
scanNote: The screenshots show the named files’ results at the time of scanning. Current reports are available through the VirusTotal links.
q1: Is the application available in English or Spanish?
a1: The application currently has a Hungarian-only interface and Spanish–Hungarian learning material. The English and Spanish versions of this page describe the product; they do not add those interface languages to the app.
q2: Do I need internet access or a Google account?
a2: Practice, personal images and licence verification work offline. Internet access may be needed to download the installer, send a licence request and install a Windows speech voice for the first time. No Google account is needed.
q3: Will my words and pictures disappear after the trial?
a3: They are not deleted. Import a licence file to continue learning after the trial; backup is also available on the activation screen. Keep regular full ZIP backups in a separate location.
q4: Why might Windows show an unknown publisher?
a4: The installer does not currently have a Windows code-signing certificate. Windows may therefore show an unknown-publisher or uncommon-download notice. Check the download source and the scan report for the named file, and keep Windows protection enabled.
footerText: Independently developed Windows software and custom websites.
